about.title: About Date Calculator
about.description: The Date Calculator performs various date calculations including adding or subtracting days, weeks, months, or years from any given date. It's essential for project planning, scheduling, legal deadlines, and personal milestone tracking. This tool handles complex date arithmetic while accounting for leap years, varying month lengths, and calendar irregularities to provide accurate results for any date calculation need.

howTo.title: How to Use the Date Calculator

steps.title: Enter Starting Date
steps.description: Select your starting date using the date picker or enter it manually in the correct format.

steps.title: Choose Operation
steps.description: Select whether you want to add time to or subtract time from your starting date.

steps.title: Select Time Unit
steps.description: Choose the time unit: days, weeks, months, or years for your calculation.

steps.title: Enter Amount
steps.description: Input the number of time units you want to add or subtract from the starting date.

steps.title: View Result
steps.description: See the calculated result date with detailed information about the calculation.

faq.q: How does it handle leap years?
faq.a: The calculator automatically accounts for leap years when adding or subtracting months and years, ensuring accurate date calculations. February 29th is properly handled in leap year calculations.

faq.q: Can I calculate business days only?
faq.a: Yes, the calculator can exclude weekends and optionally holidays when performing day-based calculations. This is useful for project planning and business scheduling.
The calculator supports dates from year 1 to 9999, covering historical dates and far future planning needs. This wide range accommodates research, genealogy, and long-term planning.
When adding months to dates like January 31st, the calculator intelligently handles cases where the target month has fewer days, typically moving to the last day of the target month.
